_doc: Stage A v1 rule set — migrated from the hand-rolled cascade in
Multipliers match config.REGIME_MULTIPLIERS as of v2.5.0.
Threshold values match config.REGIME_THRESHOLDS as of v2.5.0.
Rule order = first-match precedence. Each rule's `when` is AND.
Intended parity deviations from the original cascade:
- When `hy_spread` is missing and VIX/rvol qualify for risk-on,
the original returned trending; v1 falls to neutral (safer
direction). The original used `hy is None or hy < 3.5`; the
JSON interpreter has no None-tolerant operator yet. Rare-path
(hy is fetched daily from FRED); acceptable break.

rules._doc: PANIC — VIX high + HY at panic level (5.0+)
PANIC — VIX high + extreme negative funding (liquidation cascade, full mode)
PANIC — VIX high + HY elevated (4.5+) but not full panic level
DEFENSIVE — VIX > vix_panic with no HY corroboration → defensive (matches original ternary fallback at line 88)
NEUTRAL FLOOR — HY >= 4.0 caps regime at neutral (no risk-on)
RISK-ON TRENDING (full mode, both conditions): low VIX + vol compressed + leverage expanding
RISK-ON TRENDING (full mode, no vol-compression req): low VIX + leverage expanding
RISK-ON TRENDING (macro_only): low VIX + vol compressed (no leverage signals available)
RISK-ON CHOPPY — moderate VIX (< 22) + vol elevated (> 1.3)
